_comment: Tatoeba sentence pairs. CC BY 2.0 FR requires attribution of the contributor,
so japanese and english carry separate provenance: they are different works by
different people, and collapsing them into one credit would misattribute both.
Each record repeats the two registry ids beside the two contributor names, so a
reader of one record never has to know which half a file-level id meant.
A pair with an unnamed contributor on either half is not here — see the manifest
'deferred' list for how many were dropped and why.

records.japanese: 来週ハワイにいくつもりなので、銀行へ円を少しドルに替えにいかなければなりません。
records.english: I'm going to Hawaii next week, so I have to go and exchange some yen for dollars at the bank.

records.japanese: 来週はうちへいらしゃいませんか。
records.english: Won't you come and see me next week?

records.japanese: 来週の日曜日私たちは岡先生のためのパーティーをするつもりです。
records.english: Next Sunday we are going to have a party for Mr Oka.

records.japanese: 来週の日曜日に遊びに来てください。
records.english: Come and see me on Sunday next week.

records.japanese: 来週の土曜日は暇です。
records.english: I will be free next Saturday.

records.japanese: 来週の土曜にパーティーを開くつもりです。
records.english: We're having a party next Saturday.

records.japanese: 来週の月曜日に必ずお返しします。
records.english: I'll give it back next Monday without fail.

records.japanese: 来週の月曜日に成田を出発する予定です。
records.english: We are leaving Narita next Monday.

records.japanese: 来週の月曜日にもう一度お寄りになってみて下さい。
records.english: Try us again next Monday.

records.japanese: 来週の火曜日までにこの仕事を終わらせなければなりません。
records.english: I must get this work finished by next Tuesday.

records.japanese: 来週の火曜日に役員会がその提案を検討することになっている。
records.english: The board of directors is going to discuss the proposal next Tuesday.

records.japanese: 来週になると一家族が入ってくる。
records.english: Next week a family will move in.

records.japanese: 来週になると、何十万人もの人がその番組を見ているだろう。
records.english: Next week, millions of people will be watching the TV program.

records.japanese: 来週ジョーンズ氏と会うことになっている。
records.english: I expect to see Mr Jones next week.

records.japanese: 来週コンサートに行きます。
records.english: I am going to a concert next week.
